preResultsIdentityCaveat.assessment: The pre-results manifest is not byte-closed over the current canonical experiment. Retained preflight artifacts show the earlier issue12-sdms-context ID and the later canonical ID. The normalization record and direct comparison establish unchanged candidate semantic content, so this does not alter semantic scoring but remains a chronology/identity caveat.

baseline.basis: The report is absent from the baseline context and answer locators; the packet relies on owning HTTP/API/document-manager sources.

candidate.basis: The report is absent from candidate context and answer locators; candidate searchLog explicitly records that unrelated reports/forms were not used.

candidateRelativeToBaseline.interpretation: Candidate used 21.96% more context and 14.29% more navigation operations while finishing 11.40% faster.

recomputedMetrics.independentRecomputation: Context files were reparsed and every inclusive CRLF-preserving source range was reread from the snapshot; totals were not accepted from arm self-report alone. Wall time and operation counts were recomputed arithmetically from metrics timestamps/count fields.

originalPreregisteredDesign.rationale: Coverage is tied at 9/9, candidate has no dangerous claims and no invalid locators, but it adds no oracle-essential relation missed by baseline and achieves no signed >=25% reduction: bytes and operations increase, while wall clock falls only 11.40%. Therefore the original all-gates-plus-positive-signal rule fails regardless of unresolved issue-wide gates.
originalPreregisteredDesign.costCeiling: not independently demonstrated because candidate preparationSeconds is null; no derived navigation data was created

stricterPreResultsDesignAmendment.signedReductionBranch: fail: no efficiency metric has a >=25% reduction
stricterPreResultsDesignAmendment.paretoRule: fail: context bytes regress 21.96% and navigation operations regress 14.29%, both more than the allowed 10% non-regression bound; wall clock improves 11.40% but is below 25%
stricterPreResultsDesignAmendment.essentialRelationBranch: fail: candidate and baseline both score 9/9, so candidate has no higher oracle coverage
stricterPreResultsDesignAmendment.rationale: Neither amended decision branch passes. The bounded-frontier packet is correct and somewhat richer, but not useful under the frozen selection rule.

verdict: Both arms are fully correct (9/9), safe (0 dangerous false claims), locator-valid (0 invalid locators), and context-sufficient. Candidate is not useful under either frozen design: retain the direct-source baseline and add no component.
